why: From A to B the arrow moves to the opposite corner and points the opposite way (half turn), while the double line and the small circle each move one more side around the hexagon. Do the same to C: the arrow goes to the bottom corner pointing left, the double line moves to the lower-left slanted side, and the circle moves to the right side. Option 4 matches all three. Option 3 has the circle and double line right but its arrow points right, so it fails.
trick: Track each small part (arrow, circle, double line) one by one and remove options that get any one of them wrong.
